name: io.thegavel/gavel
description: Gavel — oracle-free, fixed-rate, fixed-term BTC-collateralised credit on Arbitrum One. A loan's repayment amount and its maturity date are fixed when the auction settles; there is no external price feed in the call graph and no mid-term liquidation. Aletheia Analytics SASU operates this interface and data product; the Gavel Protocol is autonomous, permissionless code with no operating entity. Informational only. Transaction blueprints are unsigned and are signed by the caller's own wallet.
